items.description: Trivy HIGH in Dockerfile and the built image: fix DS-0002 (image runs as root) in Dockerfile and the 2 HIGH OS-package findings in .trivy-reports/image.json (regenerate with bash scripts/trivy-scan.sh image if absent); touch only Dockerfile and, if the app needs it, the files that must change with the non-root user

Trivy HIGH in the k8s app and redpanda bases: fix KSV-0014 (root filesystem not read-only) and KSV-0118 (default security context) on the app container, the register-schemas init container and the redpanda container in k8s/base/app/app.yaml and k8s/base/redpanda/redpanda.yaml; findings in .trivy-reports/config.json (regenerate with bash scripts/trivy-scan.sh config)

Trivy HIGH in the k8s postgres data root: fix KSV-0014, KSV-0118 and KSV-0109 (ConfigMap with secrets) in k8s/data/postgres/postgres.yaml and any manifest in k8s/data/postgres/ that holds the flagged ConfigMap; findings in .trivy-reports/config.json
